segments.name: Camtek
segments.description: Sells inspection and metrology equipment for semiconductors.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one operating segment, and this segment comprises its only reporting unit.

revenueModel.text: Chip makers and packagers buy its inspection systems.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company recognizes revenue from contracts for sales of products at the point of time when the Company transfers control of the product to the customer.
